source_text: Esau: da mihi de rubro. Vendit primogenita. Profanus qui pro cibo temporary primatum spiritus vendit.
pass_a_gloss: Esau: give me of red. He-sells birthrights. Profane who for food temporary primacy of-spirit sells.
pass_b_english: [[Esau: Give me of that red stew >> Bible:Genesis 25:30]]. He sells the birthright. [[Profane is the one who for a meal sells spiritual primacy >> Bible:Hebrews 12:16]].
